name: Gaussian Rasterization Key Generation
definition: Generates key-value pairs for all Gaussian-tile overlaps to enable sorting by tile ID and depth. Each Gaussian generates one key-value pair per tile it overlaps.
summary: Gaussian Rasterization Key Generation packs tile IDs and depths into 64-bit keys to enable a single global radix sort, differing from culling or sorting methods by explicitly generating overlap entries.
